# Project Olympus

> **An Engineering Operating System for High-Performance Learning, Research, and Career Development**

## Overview

Project Olympus is a version-controlled engineering operating system designed to support long-term technical mastery, disciplined execution, research, and career development.

Instead of functioning as a collection of notes, Olympus is structured as an engineering platform with architecture, governance, automation, validation, and knowledge management principles.

The repository combines systems engineering, learning science, software engineering, and project management into a unified framework for continuous execution.

## Quick Start

Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aknoru/PROJECT-OLYMPUS.git
```

Open the repository

```bash
cd PROJECT-OLYMPUS
```

Build documentation

```bash
mkdocs serve
```

Validate repository

```bash
python scripts/validate_repository.py
```

Generate repository statistics

```bash
python scripts/generate_statistics.py
```
